0.original: Vorsaile believes it past time you were issued a personal chocobo.

1.original: To obtain your personal chocobo, you must present Cingur with a Serpent Chocobo Issuance. This document can be obtained by exchanging company seals with the serpent quartermaster. Here's hoping you have been setting aside your seals...

2.original: Cingur brings you your bird, and it is love at first sight. Name your new companion, and make it official.

3.original: After much deliberation, you decide on a name worthy of the noblest steed. Inform Cingur to complete the last of the formalities.

4.original: And so begins the adventures of <hex:022903EB0203> and <hex:022903EB3803>. May their friendship last for eternity!

24.original: Present a Serpent Chocobo Issuance to Cingur.

49.original: But tell me, have you ever felt as though you couldn't get to your destination quickly enough? That perhaps you could do with a swifter pair of legs?

50.original: If so, you might consider getting a personal chocobo. You have yet to be issued your own bird, am I correct? Given your considerable talents, you should be able to obtain one in no time at all. Let me tell you how to go about it.

51.original: First, you must obtain a Serpent Chocobo Issuance by exchanging company seals with the quartermaster. Once you have this deed, present it to our man Cingur, and he will furnish you with a suitable bird.

52.original: To be issued a personal chocobo, you must first obtain a Serpent Chocobo Issuance by exchanging company seals with the quartermaster. Once you have this deed, present it to our man Cingur, and he will furnish you with a suitable bird.

53.original: Want a bird issued, you say? Then I'll need to see your Serpent Chocobo Issuance.

54.original: Yes, everything appears to be in order.

55.original: A moment please. I'll be right back with your chocobo.

56.original: And here he is! The fellow has been in high spirits the past few bells. He must have sensed that his master was coming!

57.original: Now then, to make it official, you'll want to give your noble steed a name.

58.original: Want a bird issued, you say? Then I'll need to see your Serpent Chocobo Issuance. You can get one from the serpent quartermaster, over at the Adders' Nest.

59.original: Of course, you will need to exchange Serpent Seals for it. You can earn these by completing tasks for the Order of the Twin Adder, Gridania's Grand Company.

61.original: Now then, to make it official, you'll want to give your noble steed a name.

62.original: Heh heh! I daresay he likes his name!

63.original: Here is your very own chocobo whistle. Simply blow into it, and your feathered friend will come bounding to your side.

64.original: But do forgive him if he doesn't respond when summoned in crowded city areas or monster-infested lairs. Chocobos are stout-hearted creatures, but they have their limits.

65.original: And lastly, I present you with your chocobo rider's license, as is required by law.

66.original: And that concludes all the formalities! I wish you and your chocobo long years of fulfilling companionship!

69.original: Names must be between 2 and 20 alphabetic characters.
